title: teletext-test
source:
// M6.4 lab story. Short original lines; no long novel quotes.
=== start ===
# page:test
Nite City. Port sky: a dead channel.
* [THE STREET] -> street
* [A PAYPHONE] -> phone
* [THE CLINIC] -> clinic
* [JACK IN] -> jack

=== street ===
# page:text
Capsules stacked over Chiba. Neon kanji as mosaic blocks.
* [BACK] -> start

=== phone ===
# page:phone
# ring
A payphone rings as you pass. Wintermute.
* [PICK UP] -> pickup
* [WALK ON] -> start

=== pickup ===
# page:text
A chip voice. Then the dial tone.
* [BACK] -> start

=== clinic ===
# page:text
The black clinic. Cheap, and they know your name.
* [BACK] -> start

=== jack ===
# page:text
Trodes. The deck warms. Ready to jack in.
* [BACK] -> start
